subject.title: fix(ci): persist warm runtime caches across runs

question: Should this protected CI change merge only after a controlled exact-head warm-and-later-restore proof, or should maintainers explicitly accept a post-land rollout with rollback monitoring?
rationale: The cache writer is intentionally serialized on canonical main, and the PR states that the only decisive visibility check occurs after landing; this is an operational rollout choice rather than a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Require exact-head restore proof
options.body: Run a controlled warmer on this PR head and capture a separate later restore of both the immutable runtime cache and v5 dependency marker before merge.

options.title: Accept monitored post-land rollout
options.body: Merge with an explicit owner for the first warmer, later main restore check, and rollback if either cache remains cold or stale.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head restore proof
recommendation.body: Run a controlled warmer on this PR head and capture a separate later restore of both the immutable runtime cache and v5 dependency marker before merge.
